Oro rhino orbital mucormycosis - oral cavity, orbits and nasal cavity\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EBrain\u0026nbsp; - CVA (Acute infarct in left frontal \u0026amp; temporal lobes)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EPrimary Etiology - Diabetes Mellitus type 2 --\u0026gt; Mucormycosis\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" readability=\"7\"\u003EHTN - CVA (Acute infarct in left frontal \u0026amp; temporal lobes\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E2) What is the efficacy of drugs used along with other non pharmacological \u0026nbsp;treatment modalities and how would \u0026nbsp;you approach this patient as a treating physician?\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E'Although amphotericin B deoxycholate (AmB) was the cornerstone of mucormycosis therapy for decades, lipid formulations of AmB are significantly less nephrotoxic and can be safely administered at higher doses for a longer period of time than AmB. Furthermore, treatment of mucormycosis with liposomal amphotericin B (LAmB) was associated with a 67% survival rate, compared to 39% survival when patients were treated with AmB (\u003Cem\u003Ep\u003C\/em\u003E = 0.02)'.\u0026nbsp;Multiple other, more recent case series also found initial therapy with LAmB to be substantially more effective than other options.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;Available data indicate advantages of LAmB over amphotericin B lipid complex (ABLC) for the treatment of CNS mucormycosis. For example, LAmB levels achieved in rabbit brain were fivefold above ABLC levels .\u0026nbsp;Furthermore, while similarly effective in neutropenic mice, LAmB was markedly superior to ABLC in diabetic ketoacidotic (DKA) mice infected with\u0026nbsp;\u003Cem\u003ERhizopus oryzae\u003C\/em\u003E, primarily because of superior clearance of fungus from the brain. These animal studies are complemented by a recent, relatively small retrospective case series, in which the outcomes of patients with rhino-orbital-cerebral mucormycosis were found to be worse when ABLC was used as initial therapy versus AmB or LAmB'\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC2947016\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC2947016\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EPatients with ROCM were studied for the efficacy of polyene- caspofungin therapy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EForty-one patients with biopsy-proven ROCM were identified over 12 years; 23 (56%) of these patients were Hispanic, and 34 (83%) were diabetic. Patients treated with polyene-caspofungin therapy (6 evaluable patients) had superior success (100% vs. 45%;\u0026nbsp;\u003Cem\u003EP\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026nbsp;= .02) and Kaplan-Meier survival time (\u003Cem\u003EP\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026nbsp;= .02), compared with patients treated with polyene monotherapy. Patients treated with amphotericin B lipid complex had inferior success (37% vs. 72%;\u0026nbsp;\u003Cem\u003EP\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026nbsp;= .03) and a higher clinical failure rate (45% vs. 21%;\u0026nbsp;\u003Cem\u003EP\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026nbsp;= .04), compared with patients who received other polyenes. However, patients treated with amphotericin B lipid complex plus caspofungin had superior success (100% vs. 20%;\u0026nbsp;\u003Cem\u003EP\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026nbsp;= .009) and survival time (\u003Cem\u003EP\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026nbsp;= .01), compared with patients who received amphotericin B lipid complex alone. The benefit of combination therapy, compared with monotherapy, was most pronounced in patients with cerebral involvement (success rate, 100% vs. 25%;\u0026nbsp;\u003Cem\u003EP\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026nbsp;= .01). In multivariate analysis, only receipt of combination therapy was significantly associated with improved outcomes (\u003Cem\u003EP\u003C\/em\u003E\u0026nbsp;= .02).'\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\n \u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhvDx1VCoN3JpW2oG7uZ13dUYO3DpoJESXy5xFggHaC32PRIfai1KmbTwkfMCBdRG8Or-KGBfhOd7ZYaOlr0DHfyhkNVZ2lt4XXn6jowxxDHzkIUuex1_6CGfwvFYRgHuE3cGhTBaosAek\/s1600\/1623660634114881-0.png\" imageanchor=\"1\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\n \u003Cimg border=\"0\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhvDx1VCoN3JpW2oG7uZ13dUYO3DpoJESXy5xFggHaC32PRIfai1KmbTwkfMCBdRG8Or-KGBfhOd7ZYaOlr0DHfyhkNVZ2lt4XXn6jowxxDHzkIUuex1_6CGfwvFYRgHuE3cGhTBaosAek\/s1600\/1623660634114881-0.png\" width=\"400\"\u003E\n \u003C\/a\u003E\n\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC2793535\/?report=reader#!po=39.1892\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC2793535\/?report=reader#!po=39.1892\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E3) What are the postulated reasons for a sudden apparent rise in the incidence of mucormycosis in India at this point of time?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EMucormycosis occurs in immunocompromised patients. font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb style=\"background-color: white; color: #4285f4; font-family: arial, tahoma, helvetica, freesans, sans-serif; font-size: 15.84px;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/medicinedepartment.blogspot.com\/2021\/02\/blended-bimonthly-assessment-dec-2020.html?m=1\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Emedicinedepartment.blogspot.\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Ecom\/2021\/02\/blended-bimonthly-\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Eassessment-dec-2020.html?m=1\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: #fdfaf0; font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECase 1.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cb style=\"background-color: transparent; color: #4285f4;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/ashakiran923.blogspot.com\/2021\/03\/60-years-old-male-fever-under-evaluation.html?m=1\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/ashakiran923.blogspot.\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Ecom\/2021\/03\/60-years-old-male-\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Efever-under-evaluation.html?m=\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003E1\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ea). What is the problem representation of this patient and what is the anatomical localization for his current problem based on the clinical findings?How specific is his dilated superficial Abdominal vein in making diagnosis?\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr style=\"background-color: white; color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 13.696px;\" \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E1. The problem representation:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EA 60 year old man who was a smoker and alcoholic, has been on conservative treatment for CKD presented with fever and dyspnea since 15 days\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E2. Anatomical localization:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EHere, from the history of fever since 15 days and dyspnea which initially was only on exertion and which later on progressed to at rest, he had no complaints of orthopnea, bendopnea, chest pain or palpitations\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EAlong with facial puffiness\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EThis picture could suggest the possibilities of :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003ERenal failure\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EHeart failure\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003ELiver pathology\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EAs the heart failure symptoms have been ruled out, from the history it suggests probably the presence of a renal or a liver pathology.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EAnd the investigations shows a picture of urinary tract infection on an already present chronic kidney disease\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EAlong with hypoalbuminaemia, raised alkaline phosphatase and pancytopenia suggesting a liver failure.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003ESo this gives an anatomical location of\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EUTI on Chronic kidney disease\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003ELiver failure.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E2.\u0026nbsp;And with the presence of dilated abdominal veins suggests a liver pathology.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EDilated abdominal vein is important in differentiation cirrhosis from vena caval obstruction. In patients with dilated abdominal wall veins due to cirrhosis, the direction of blood flow is away from the umbilicus (radiating like a star from the umbilicus), whereas in vena caval obstruction, the direction of blood flow is either completely above downward (superior venacaval obstruction) or completely below upward (inferior venacaval obstruction).\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC2665972\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC2665972\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Eb) What is the etiology of the current problem and how would you as a member of the treating team arrive at a diagnosis? What is the cause of his hypoalbuminemia?Why is the SAAG low?\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EB.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E1. Etiology to the current problems:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EFever is because of urinary tract infection\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EDyspnea and facial puffiness is because of AKI on already pre existing kidney failure\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EAKI on CKD\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EThe patient also gives a history of being diagnosed outside of renal failure around 3 months back and also has received 1 hemodialysis session in another hospital and has been on conservative management since then.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E2.\u0026nbsp;Low SAAG ascites (\u0026lt;1.1 g\/dL) is usually caused by peritoneal malignancies, chronic peritoneal infection (i.e., mycobacterium tuberculosis), and nephrotic syndrome.\u0026nbsp;Low serum oncotic pressure can also cause low SAAG ascites. Testing for nephrotic syndrome and protein‐losing enteropathy should be performed in patients with low SAAG ascites and a suspicion of either one of these conditions.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EIn patients with cirrhotic ascites, the presence of more than 250 polymorphonuclear cells (PMNs) is consistent with spontaneous bacterial peritonitis. The PMN count can also be elevated in pancreatic ascites, but the SAAG in these patients will be less than 1.1 g\/dL.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EHowever in this patient, the ascitic cell count doesn’t give a picture of peritonitis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEg0rfZ9wjfZxqHGj_Cq0s_1LbyIevCjkHiPe1ARVe_5EGQQ1nMhaPlyJz6mmqUwNQKvWqxMpJkPPDf9BLyjqWocZZc3_cX7d9YzXmKRfVa40DcUpzrhWiDoE0HYXzRQ8DT_IogwmbtUrHU\/s896\/saag.jpeg\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"642\" data-original-width=\"896\" height=\"458\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEg0rfZ9wjfZxqHGj_Cq0s_1LbyIevCjkHiPe1ARVe_5EGQQ1nMhaPlyJz6mmqUwNQKvWqxMpJkPPDf9BLyjqWocZZc3_cX7d9YzXmKRfVa40DcUpzrhWiDoE0HYXzRQ8DT_IogwmbtUrHU\/w640-h458\/saag.jpeg\" width=\"640\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; font-family: arial; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/aasldpubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com\/doi\/10.1002\/cld.537\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/aasldpubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com\/doi\/10.1002\/cld.537\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; font-family: arial; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; font-family: arial; text-align: center;\"\u003E3. The cause for his hypoalbuminaemia\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; font-family: arial; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; font-family: arial; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; font-family: arial; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEjQnQGg_1kNJLvlyBWB7e-69vGRdgZEp0oXw8vFYAbeXG18qNbyJOYSobwX5mgs43FDFIFn7htetOKgJY6x_t2V08MiRF9VB9fgdCeSx39RqFu0G3G_z9zx-T_9pcVaIzqCsITP5Fqpe6U\/s1114\/hypoalbuminaemia.jpeg\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"1114\" data-original-width=\"907\" height=\"640\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEjQnQGg_1kNJLvlyBWB7e-69vGRdgZEp0oXw8vFYAbeXG18qNbyJOYSobwX5mgs43FDFIFn7htetOKgJY6x_t2V08MiRF9VB9fgdCeSx39RqFu0G3G_z9zx-T_9pcVaIzqCsITP5Fqpe6U\/w522-h640\/hypoalbuminaemia.jpeg\" width=\"522\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.researchgate.net\/figure\/Albumin-synthesis-distribution-and-elimination_fig1_319106735\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.researchgate.net\/figure\/Albumin-synthesis-distribution-and-elimination_fig1_319106735\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003EThis beautiful diagram shows the synthesis, distribution and elimination of albumin in the human body.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003EThe cause for his hypoalbuminaemia is because of the liver failure.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003EThe urine doesn’t show significant albuminuria.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;\"\u003EThe hypoalbuminaemia could also be because it acts a negative phase reactant in infectious conditions.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr style=\"font-family: \u0026quot;Times New Roman\u0026quot;; text-align: left;\" \/\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ec)Will PT,INR derangement preceed hypoalbuminemia in liver dysfunction??Share reference articles if any!\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003ELiver disease results in complex alterations of all 3 phases of hemostasis: primary hemostasis, coagulation, and fibrinolysis. Liver is the site of synthesis of fibrinogen and factors II, V, VII, IX, X, XI, XII.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003EIn acute liver failure, plasma concentration of coagulation factors first those with the shortest half life, factor V and VII (12 h and 4-6 h respectively), and factors II, VII and X subsequently. Factor VIII, together with vWf is usually elevated.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC4087534\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC4087534\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003EHowever the half life of albumin is around 20 days, which points towards that the coagulation profile will be first deranged prior to hypoalbuminaemia.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ed)What is the etiology of his fever and pancytopenia?\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003EThe cause for his fever can be attributed to his Urinary tract infection and the cause for his pancytopenia is because of liver failure.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ee)Can there be conditions with severe hypoalbuminemia but no pedal edema? Can one have hereditary analbuminemia and yet have minimal edema? Please go this article\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.frontiersin.org\/articles\/10.3389\/fgene.2019.00336\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.frontiersin.org\/articles\/10.3389\/fgene.2019.00336\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u0026nbsp;full and answer the question.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E1. As an acute phase reactant:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EThe liver responds to infections and inflammations by producing a large number of APRs. At the same time, the production of a number of other proteins is reduced, these are therefore referred to as “negative” APPs. Negative APPs are albumin, transferring, transthyretin, transcortin, and retinol-binding protein.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC3053509\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC3053509\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E2. Protein-losing enteropathy is a syndrome where there is an excess loss of proteins in the gastrointestinal tract.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E3. Nutritional Hypoalbuminaemia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EThey have low serum albumin levels due to a decreased supply of amino acids to the liver as well as other nutritional deficiencies.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003EYes hereditary hypoalbuminaemia can have minimal edema. According to this article,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E‘Clinically, in addition to the low level of albumin, the patients almost always have hyperlipidemia, but they usually also have mild oedema, reduced blood pressure and fatigue.'\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ef) What is the efficacy of each of the drugs listed in his current treatment plan\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E1. NITROFURANTOIN:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003ERandomised controlled trial of nitrofurantoin versus placebo in the treatment of uncomplicated urinary tract infection in adult women\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EP - 78 patients with UTI\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EI - 40 patients were randomised to receive nitrofurantoin 100 mg\u0026nbsp; four times daily for three days.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EC - 38 patients received Placebo\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EO - The result for combined symptomatic improvement and cure after three days was 27\/35 in the nitrofurantoin group and 19\/35 in the placebo group. After seven days, combined improvement and cure was observed in 30\/34 and 17\/33 respectively.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u0026nbsp;After seven days the bacteriological cure rate was 17\/23 in the intervention group and 9\/22 in the placebo group.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ewomen with bacteriologically proven UTI, nitrofurantoin was significantly more effective than placebo in achieving bacteriological cure and symptomatic relief in just three days; this was still present after seven days. In patients with clinically suspected UTI the symptomatic effect was statistically significant after.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.researchgate.net\/publication\/11154981_Randomised_controlled_trial_of_nitrofurantoin_versus_placebo_in_the_treatment_of_uncomplicated_urinary_tract_infection_in_adult_women\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.researchgate.net\/publication\/11154981_Randomised_controlled_trial_of_nitrofurantoin_versus_placebo_in_the_treatment_of_uncomplicated_urinary_tract_infection_in_adult_women\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E2. TAMSULOSIN:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; font-weight: bold;\"\u003ERandomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial conducted at 95 urology clinics in the United States involving men 40 years and above\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; font-weight: bold;\"\u003EI - Patients were randomly assigned to receive placebo (n = 222), 4 mg of tolterodine ER (n = 217), 0.4 mg of tamsulosin (n = 215), or both tolterodine ER plus tamsulosin (n = 225) for 12 weeks.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; font-weight: bold;\"\u003EC - total of 172 men (80%) receiving tolterodine ER plus tamsulosin reported treatment benefit by week 12 compared with 132 patients (62%) receiving placebo (P\u0026lt;.001), 146 (71%) receiving tamsulosin, or 135 (65%)\u0026nbsp; receiving tolterodine. Patients receiving tolterodine ER plus tamsulosin compared with placebo experienced significant reductions in urgency urinary incontinence, urgency episodes without incontinence, micturitions per 24 hours, and micturitions per night.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial; font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EO- These results suggest that treatment with tolterodine ER plus tamsulosin for 12 weeks provides benefit for men with moderate to severe lower urinary tract symptoms including overactive bladder.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"goog_617727586\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/jamanetwork.com\/journals\/jama\/fullarticle\/204147\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/jamanetwork.com\/journals\/jama\/fullarticle\/204147\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E2nd Case:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E45year old female with abdominal distension\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/navyamallempalli.blogspot.com\/2021\/02\/dr_6.html\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/navyamallempalli.blogspot.com\/2021\/02\/dr_6.html\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ea). width=\"640\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EUnlike haemodialysis, an advantage of peritoneal dialysis is that regular visits to a dialysis unit are not required, and it can be carried out at home.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EAnother major disadvantage of peritoneal dialysis is that you're at risk of developing peritonitis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EIn rare cases, your peritoneum may gradually become thickened and scarred.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EAnother drawback of peritoneal dialysis is that the dialysis fluid used can cause a reduction in protein levels.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.nhs.uk\/conditions\/dialysis\/pros-cons\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.nhs.uk\/conditions\/dialysis\/pros-cons\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EAdvatanges of peritoneal dialysis:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EBetter cardiovascular stability\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ee) What is the efficacy of each of the drugs listed in his current treatment plan\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003ETo compare the efficacy of three commonly used diuretic regimens in the treatment of ascites, we randomized 90 patients to three treatment groups: Sequential Spironolactone (spironolactone followed by furosemide if necessary), Combination (spironolactone and furosemide in combination), and Furosemide (furosemide given alone).\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EDiuretics were begun at a low dose by mouth and the dosage increased until a 0.4-0.8 kg daily diuresis was achieved.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003ETo do so was far more difficult with furosemide alone, which required repetitious upward adjustments in dosage and massive KCl supplements. The incidence of encephalopathy, hepatorenal syndrome, and marked electrolyte abnormalities was similar for the three treatment groups except that severe hyperkalemia was more frequent on combination therapy. We conclude that diuresis should be initiated with one of the two spironolactone regimens and not with furosemide as the sole agent.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/7035545\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/7035545\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003Ef)What is the current outcome?and what could be the etiology of her current outcome?\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u003Cbr style=\"font-weight: 400;\" \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EThe patient was declared dead on March 14th\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EThe cause was probably due to pulmonary embolism\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003ECase 3:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E55year old male with SOB and abdominal distension,orthopnea\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/jayanth1802.blogspot.com\/2021\/02\/55-year-old-farmer-with-sob-abdominal.html?m=1\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003Ea). What is the problem representation of this patient and what is the anatomical localization for his current problem based on the clinical findings?\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EA 55 year old man, alcoholic and smoker, a known case of COPD\u0026nbsp; presented with\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EDyspnea at rest since 4 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EAbdominal distension along with scrotal swelling since 1 week\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EReduced urine output, facial puffiness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EThe anatomical localization is in the heart as it's consistent with the symptoms and the cvs examination reveled thrills in the left and right paraphernalia areas along with visible pulsations.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EPansystolic murmur was heard in Mitral and tricuspid areas.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003Eb) What is the etiology of his ascites? and how would you as a member of the treating team arrive at a diagnosis?Chart out the sequence of events!\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003ESAAG is 1.9\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EWhich suggests a high SAAG indicating portal hypertension.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EHowever this picture of High SAAG (1.9) with ascitic protein of 2.1g\/dl is seen in Cirrhosis and Late Budd Chairi. However, this patients usg abdomen shows no picture of Cirrhosis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EChronic smoker and alcoholic -------\u0026gt; COPD ---------\u0026gt;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003ECor Pulmonale -------\u0026gt; Congestive Hepatopathy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ec)What is the efficacy of each of the drugs listed in his treatment plan?\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E1. 'Bronchodilator efficacy of salbutamol (200 micrograms), salmeterol (50 micrograms) and ipratropium bromide (40 micrograms) aerosols has been compared in 16 patients with stable chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) using a double-blind placebo controlled cross-over design.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EWhen absolute changes in FEV1 were used as the response criterion, efficacy of the three drugs was significantly better than placebo (P \u0026lt; 0.05).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EThe onset of bronchodilatation after ipratropium bromide was slower than after salbutamol, but ipratropium induced more and longer-lasting bronchodilatation than the adrenergic drug. Salmeterol was slower but its duration was longer than salbutamol. The onset of the effect of salmeterol was slower than ipratropium bromide, but salmeterol showed, on average, superior bronchodilator efficacy compared with the anticholinergic agent, sustaining bronchodilation longer than ipratropium bromide (responses to salmeterol were significantly (P \u0026lt; 0.05) greater than those to ipratropium bromide from 4-12 h time period, but from 15 min to 1 h time periods response to ipratropium bromide exceeded salmeterol). The mean FEV1 area under the curve was significantly (P \u0026lt; 0.05) larger after salmeterol when compared to ipratropium bromide and salbutamol. Moreover, the mean FEV1 area under the curve after ipratropium bromide was significantly.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EO-\u0026nbsp; Salmeterol compares favourably with ipratropium bromide in terms of effects on lung function at clinically recommended doses because it has a longer duration of action than ipratropium bromide. The longer dosing intervals, which may enhance compliance, encourage its administration in patients with COPD.'\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/8819181\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/8819181\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E2.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003EThis study suggests that a low-sodium and fluid-restricted diet, compared with a non-restricted diet, for patients hospitalized with acute decompensated heart failure does not expedite weight loss or decrease congestion.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EThis is a randomized controlled trial\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EPatients in the intervention group (n = 38) had a fluid intake of 800 mL per day and a sodium intake of 800 mg per day until discharge or hospital day 7, whichever came first.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;Patients in the control group (n = 37) received liberal fluids and sodium (at least 2.5 L per day and 3 to 5 g per day, respectively).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EPatients in both groups lost approximately 4.5 kg (10 lb) of body weight during this time. The restricted group had significantly greater perceived thirst than the control group. At 30-day follow-up, patients in the restricted group were noted to be slightly more congested, with a clinical congestion score 2.4 points higher than the control group, but there was no difference in 30-day readmission rates between the groups. Given the small sample size, this study was likely underpowered to detect such a difference if it exists.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"goog_1564501507\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"goog_1564501507\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.aafp.org\/afp\/2013\/1201\/od2.html\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.aafp.org\/afp\/2013\/1201\/od2.html\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ed) What are his current outcomes?\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EThe patient was declared dead due to a cardiopulmonary arrest as a result of\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003Eacute exacerbation of COPD with cor pulmonale and Severe PAH\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"mail-message expanded\" id=\"m2261\"\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"mail-message-content collapsible zoom-normal mail-show-images\" style=\"margin: 16px 0px; overflow-wrap: break-word;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"clear\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EQUESTION 4\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E4)Please go through the thesis presentation below and answer the questions below by also discussing them with the presenter\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Ca data-saferedirecturl=\"https:\/\/www.google.com\/url?hl=en\u0026amp;q=https:\/\/youtu.be\/QlPrb1BSHGE\u0026amp;source=gmail\u0026amp;ust=1615917966904000\u0026amp;usg=AFQjCNGdH-C35pvH10hiaPERmPmcHypEag\" href=\"https:\/\/youtu.be\/QlPrb1BSHGE\" style=\"color: #4285f4; text-decoration-line: none;\" target=\"_blank\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ehttps:\/\/youtu.be\/QlPrb1BSHGE\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ea)What was the research question in the above thesis presentation?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003ETo evaluate the etiology of ascites through SAAG\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Eb) What was the researcher's hypothesis?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EAccording to the researcher, SAAG is better for etiological diagnosis for ascites when compared to\u0026nbsp; ascitic fluid total protein\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ec)What is the current available sensitivity and specificity of SAAG in diagnosis of etiology of ascites\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EThe aim of this study was to define a new reasonable threshold of SAAG in Chinese ascitic patients.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EAdult patients with ascites admitted to the Shanghai Changzheng Hospital from Jan 2004 to Jun 2010 were retrospectively analyzed. The diagnostic criteria for cirrhotic ascites are clinical manifestations, radiological features and esophageal-gastric varicosis, or histopathology.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EThe mean value of SAAG in portal-hypertension-related ascites was significantly higher than that in the non-portal-hypertension-related ascites (21.15 ± 4.38 g\/L vs 7.48 ± 3.64 g\/L, P = 0.002). The SAAG cut-off value under 12.50 g\/L predicted portal hypertension ascites with the sensitivity of 99.20%, specificity of 95.10% and accuracy of 97.65%.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003ESAAG is useful to distinguish portal-hypertension-related ascites and non-portal-hypertension-related ascites, and 12.50 g\/L might present as a more reasonable threshold in Chinese ascitic patients.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"goog_1564501508\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/diagnosticpathology.biomedcentral.com\/articles\/10.1186\/1746-1596-8-143\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/diagnosticpathology.biomedcentral.com\/articles\/10.1186\/1746-1596-8-143\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E5) Journal club questions on Ascites theme\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ea) Please identify the study design and outcomes in the article linked here\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca data-saferedirecturl=\"https:\/\/www.google.com\/url?hl=en\u0026amp;q=https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6644216\/\u0026amp;source=gmail\u0026amp;ust=1615917966905000\u0026amp;usg=AFQjCNHt-7P0SF-I_b53ZXf4daiWoW36qg\" href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6644216\/\" style=\"color: #4285f4; text-decoration-line: none;\" target=\"_blank\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Egov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6644216\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u0026nbsp;as well as the thesis linked here\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca data-saferedirecturl=\"https:\/\/www.google.com\/url?hl=en\u0026amp;q=https:\/\/chandanavishwanatham19.blogspot.com\/2021\/03\/of-thesis-clinical-profileevaluationdia.html\u0026amp;source=gmail\u0026amp;ust=1615917966905000\u0026amp;usg=AFQjCNGXivgvpmSr0lkr5J78rt1DEi6Nww\" href=\"https:\/\/chandanavishwanatham19.blogspot.com\/2021\/03\/of-thesis-clinical-profileevaluationdia.html\" style=\"color: #4285f4; text-decoration-line: none;\" target=\"_blank\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Echandanavishwanatham19.\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Eblogspot.com\/2021\/03\/of-\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Ethesis-clinical-\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Eprofileevaluationdia.html\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EThe study design here is a Prospective type of study\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EA total of 52 patients were included in this study from November 1, 2018 to March 30, 2019.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EChronic liver disease (CLD) was the major cause of ascites in this study in 24 (46.2%) patients. The other main causes of ascites were heart failure from various causes (19.2%), tuberculosis and hepatosplenic schistosomiasis contributing to 11.5% each and chronic kidney disease (5.8%). Five (20.8%) CLD patients had spontaneous bacterial peritonitis as a complication. Five (20.8%) and 4 (16.7%) CLD patients had hepatocellular carcinoma and hepatic encephalopathy as complications, respectively. Nine (17.3%) patients had variceal bleeding; six of the patients were diagnosed to have CLD while the remaining patients were having hepatosplenic schistosomiasis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Eb) Please download the CASP diagnostic study checklist here\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca data-saferedirecturl=\"https:\/\/www.google.com\/url?hl=en\u0026amp;q=https:\/\/casp-uk.net\/casp-tools-checklists\/\u0026amp;source=gmail\u0026amp;ust=1615917966905000\u0026amp;usg=AFQjCNF_QdT564s8zeICFCprys87phF95Q\" href=\"https:\/\/casp-uk.net\/casp-tools-checklists\/\" style=\"color: #4285f4; font-family: \u0026quot;Times New Roman\u0026quot;;\"\u003E\u003Cb style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EQUESTION 4\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E4)Please go through the thesis presentation below and answer the questions below by also discussing them with the presenter\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Ca data-saferedirecturl=\"https:\/\/www.google.com\/url?hl=en\u0026amp;q=https:\/\/youtu.be\/QlPrb1BSHGE\u0026amp;source=gmail\u0026amp;ust=1615917966904000\u0026amp;usg=AFQjCNGdH-C35pvH10hiaPERmPmcHypEag\" href=\"https:\/\/youtu.be\/QlPrb1BSHGE\" style=\"color: #4285f4; text-decoration-line: none;\" target=\"_blank\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ehttps:\/\/youtu.be\/QlPrb1BSHGE\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ea)What was the research question in the above thesis presentation?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003ETo evaluate the etiology of ascites through SAAG\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Eb) What was the researcher's hypothesis?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EAccording to the researcher, SAAG is better for etiological diagnosis for ascites when compared to\u0026nbsp; ascitic fluid total protein\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ec)What is the current available sensitivity and specificity of SAAG in diagnosis of etiology of ascites\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EThe aim of this study was to define a new reasonable threshold of SAAG in Chinese ascitic patients.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EAdult patients with ascites admitted to the Shanghai Changzheng Hospital from Jan 2004 to Jun 2010 were retrospectively analyzed. The diagnostic criteria for cirrhotic ascites are clinical manifestations, radiological features and esophageal-gastric varicosis, or histopathology.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EThe mean value of SAAG in portal-hypertension-related ascites was significantly higher than that in the non-portal-hypertension-related ascites (21.15 ± 4.38 g\/L vs 7.48 ± 3.64 g\/L, P = 0.002). The SAAG cut-off value under 12.50 g\/L predicted portal hypertension ascites with the sensitivity of 99.20%, specificity of 95.10% and accuracy of 97.65%.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003ESAAG is useful to distinguish portal-hypertension-related ascites and non-portal-hypertension-related ascites, and 12.50 g\/L might present as a more reasonable threshold in Chinese ascitic patients.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"goog_1564501508\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/diagnosticpathology.biomedcentral.com\/articles\/10.1186\/1746-1596-8-143\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/diagnosticpathology.biomedcentral.com\/articles\/10.1186\/1746-1596-8-143\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E5) Journal club questions on Ascites theme\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ea) Please identify the study design and outcomes in the article linked here\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca data-saferedirecturl=\"https:\/\/www.google.com\/url?hl=en\u0026amp;q=https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6644216\/\u0026amp;source=gmail\u0026amp;ust=1615917966905000\u0026amp;usg=AFQjCNHt-7P0SF-I_b53ZXf4daiWoW36qg\" href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6644216\/\" style=\"color: #4285f4; text-decoration-line: none;\" target=\"_blank\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Egov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6644216\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u0026nbsp;as well as the thesis linked here\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca data-saferedirecturl=\"https:\/\/www.google.com\/url?hl=en\u0026amp;q=https:\/\/chandanavishwanatham19.blogspot.com\/2021\/03\/of-thesis-clinical-profileevaluationdia.html\u0026amp;source=gmail\u0026amp;ust=1615917966905000\u0026amp;usg=AFQjCNGXivgvpmSr0lkr5J78rt1DEi6Nww\" href=\"https:\/\/chandanavishwanatham19.blogspot.com\/2021\/03\/of-thesis-clinical-profileevaluationdia.html\" style=\"color: #4285f4; text-decoration-line: none;\" target=\"_blank\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Echandanavishwanatham19.\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Eblogspot.com\/2021\/03\/of-\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Ethesis-clinical-\u003Cwbr\u003E\u003C\/wbr\u003Eprofileevaluationdia.html\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EThe study design here is a Prospective type of study\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EA total of 52 patients were included in this study from November 1, 2018 to March 30, 2019.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003EChronic liver disease (CLD) was the major cause of ascites in this study in 24 (46.2%) patients. The other main causes of ascites were heart failure from various causes (19.2%), tuberculosis and hepatosplenic schistosomiasis contributing to 11.5% each and chronic kidney disease (5.8%). Five (20.8%) CLD patients had spontaneous bacterial peritonitis as a complication. Five (20.8%) and 4 (16.7%) CLD patients had hepatocellular carcinoma and hepatic encephalopathy as complications, respectively. Nine (17.3%) patients had variceal bleeding; six of the patients were diagnosed to have CLD while the remaining patients were having hepatosplenic schistosomiasis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Eb) Please download
